guarantees.claim: For each share i, all (x,y), rho_data[i][x][y] is assigned the rotation of theta_data[i][x][y] with amount = RhoOffset[5*x+y]%W.
When Offset (RhoOffset[5*x+y]%W) equals 0, rho_out[x][y] is directly assigned from rho_in[x][y] with no rotation.
When Offset is non-zero, rho_out[x][y] = {rho_in[x][y][0 +: ShiftAmt], rho_in[x][y][ShiftAmt +: Offset]}, where ShiftAmt = W - Offset.

assumptions.claim: All entries in the RhoOffset parameter array are non-negative integers.
assumptions.risk: If any RhoOffset entry is negative, Offset can become negative, leading to ShiftAmt > W and potentially illegal part-select width (zero or negative width), causing X propagation or synthesis failure.

uncertain_points.claim: The code does not enforce that RhoOffset entries are non-negative; if a negative value appears, Offset = RhoOffset[5*x+y]%W can be negative, causing ShiftAmt > W and resulting part-select [ShiftAmt +: Offset] to have an illegal width (zero or negative).
uncertain_points.risk: RTL may produce X values or fail synthesis; rotation correctness is broken, potentially exposing share information in a masked Keccak implementation.
